draft.subject: your intake coordinator role
draft.body:
Hi Diane,

Congratulations on the merger with Ellery Price. I also saw Abernathy Cole is hiring an intake coordinator to take enquiries and run conflict checks, which usually means client data moving through more hands.

We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture.

Worth a look?

claims.text: Congratulations on the merger with Ellery Price
Abernathy Cole is hiring an intake coordinator to take enquiries and run conflict checks
We built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture

evidence.text: Intake Coordinator. Be the first voice new clients hear: take enquiries, run conflict checks and book consultations.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

findings.span: Congratulations on the merger with Ellery Price
